floor_history.headline: recon: retired body 65 -> recovered WIP score-8 form transfers at 7 on soft-float -> int-typed stride+base sum gives 6; last 6 = sched1 LUID tie between the a2-site init and the call arg loads, proven
Floor holds at 6 (176/176, RA byte-identical to target); 16 structural spellings measured, both banked frontier routes F1 and F2 retired with mechanism cites, residual is a pure 3-insn emission-order

Judge-FAILed nv/nw body retired from candidate.c; measured that every source-level hoist of the a2 base costs a tenth callee-saved seat (+2 insns) and is not target-shaped; the s3 reg_n_sets mechanism

1,224 spellings swept: the a2-site region collapses to {6,15}, every neutral axis is an 800/800 byte-level no-op, and sched.c's own source names the residual as a LUID-ordering problem no source state

frontier.hypothesis: The residual is a post-expand re-emission problem: some pass moves the a2 arithmetic below the call's argument setup in the FAILed nv/nw bodies, and naming that pass is the prerequisite to finding an ordinary-C trigger for it.
frontier.mechanism: rank_for_schedule reaches the INSN_LUID tie-break (sched.c:2464) only when INSN_PRIORITY (sched.c:2418) ties, and the a2 base insn's dependence path to the block end is strictly longer than the argument setup's, so the arithmetic insn must physically be re-emitted below the argument setup. Candidates are cse.c re-materialization at the copy, combine.c folding the copy into the arithmetic at the copy site, or flow.c deleting the now-dead early set.
frontier.next_probe: pwsh tools/grinder/dump.ps1 func_8005D554 with rejected/judge-failed-fresh-multiwrite-nv-nw-carrier-scores-0.c applied, then again with candidate.c applied; diff the .cse, .combine and .flow dumps around the a2 base insn to name the transformation, then search for a real program-motivated copy that reproduces it without an invented multi-write carrier.

frontier.hypothesis: The untried side of the tie is the ARGUMENT SETUP, not the a2 base: if the function had a single func_80073728 call site in the source, reg_n_sets for the hard argument registers would be 1, birthing_insn_p would fire, and adjust_priority would raise the argument setup to max_priority -- putting it ahead of the a2 base without touching the a2 base at all.
frontier.mechanism: birthing_insn_p (tools/gcc-2.7.2/sched.c:2526) returns nonzero iff the destination register is live and reg_n_sets[REGNO] == 1; adjust_priority (sched.c:2584) then raises INSN_PRIORITY to max_priority, which wins term 1 of rank_for_schedule (sched.c:2418) outright. Both hard argument registers are currently set at two call sites, so the bump never fires. This route has never been measured in four sessions.
frontier.next_probe: Write a single-call-site chassis in ordinary C -- both halves funnelled through one func_80073728 call, e.g. a two-iteration inner loop over the per-half constants held in a small local table, or an if/else selecting the constants and falling into a shared call -- measure it with sandbox --disable all, and if the argument setup does move ahead of the a2 base, work on getting that form back to 176 instructions.

frontier.hypothesis: The residual lives in block structure or the object model, not in local spelling: the enumerated space proves invariance inside the block, and the untried structural axes are the loop form, the guard shape, and the declared shape of s / D_8009B2E0.
frontier.mechanism: Changing the loop form (the s2 z3 while + duplicated guard, which is neutral at 6 but sits OUTSIDE the enum3 space) or replacing the `p_b2e0 = (u8 *)&D_8009B2E0` declaration pun with a real declared object changes which insns exist in the block and therefore changes the INSN_LUID sequence the tie-break at sched.c:2464 reads.
frontier.next_probe: Rebuild the s2 z3 guard-duplicated-while body on the current chassis, confirm it still measures 6/176, then re-run gen3.py's arithmetic x declaration-scope cross product on top of it (about 200 spellings) to test whether the score stays invariant once the block structure changes.

judge_constraints: No fresh (invented) local may be written more than once to act as a staging carrier for the a2-site base `(s32)r4 - K` or for any other value in this function, under any name; the existing-local borrow quadrant (staged-value-reused-variable, all six bounds) and the alternate-chassis route (frontier item 2, e.g. the z3 guard-duplicated while) remain open.
